chapter_seo_title: A Mortal's Journey - Ch 487: The Golden Silk Silkworm's Fiery Crash and Han Li's Quiet Win
og_title: The Great Cauldron Heist Flops Hard
og_description: The Azure Herb wears off, sending the righteous faction's grand plan up in smoke. Han Li quietly pockets the loss.
twitter_description: Wan Tianming's precious silkworms crash out. Man Brutal Beard laughs. Han Li collects the scraps.

lore_anchors.definition: A rare spirit herb used to temporarily force-raise a creature's cultivation, causing a massive backlash once the effect wears off.
A famous and rare spirit insect capable of immense physical strength and producing indestructible silk; highly prized in the cultivation world.
The supreme ancient treasure sealed in the deepest chamber of the Void Heaven Palace, the primary objective of the entire expedition.
A unique, artificially nurtured spirit spider with a special ability to counter the spatial restrictions within the Void Heaven Palace.
The scholar-robed Nascent Soul cultivator of the demonic path, a member of the temporary alliance.
The pleasure derived from the misfortune of others; here, it perfectly describes the demonic side's reaction to the righteous faction's failure.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Wan Tianming just abandon the silkworms?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Because they were completely crippled by the Azure Herb backlash. Keeping them would be a waste of resources with no chance of recovery, so he cut his losses.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Han Li want the broken silkworms?
cultural_notes_faq.a: In the Mortal Stream, a discarded asset is still an asset. Even in a crippled state, a Golden Silk Silkworm might yield useful materials or secrets Han Li can study later.
